experiments.scope: Matched browser-service runtime comparison: one selected affected target plus a Cloudflare denial and an ordinary-content control, five rounds. No full API or all-target claim.

limits: The 26/36 exploratory probe stopped on its resource guard. The failing sample was not persisted before the guard raised; its exact event is unknown. No complete probe rate or final-health claim.
The first 30-response runtime comparison passed its original verifier but showed Trustpilot 0/5 in both runtimes because Verified! Redirecting... was captured early.

The revised comparison captured all 30 planned responses; its original post-run URL check failed on the legitimate /review/amazon.com -> /review/www.amazon.com canonical alias. This corrected offline audit explicitly allows those two paths only, verifies the Amazon Reviews title and rendered review content, and preserves all original artifacts and scores. No additional requests were sent.

The revised runner exited before persisting report/timing diagnostics and the launcher did not capture final health. Per-response closed-page/owner proofs, resource samples and stopped/removed container receipts are verified separately; no final-health or uninterrupted-clock claim is inferred.
Matched selected targets and five rounds do not establish an all-target improvement, extraction F1 or hosted parity.
